```{r}
# Four fertilizer treatments, five replicates each
treat <- rep(c("Urea", "NPK", "Compost", "Mixed"), each = 5)
```


```{r}
yield <- c(4.2, 4.8, 4.0, 4.5, 4.4,    # Urea
            5.3, 4.7, 5.1, 5.5, 4.9,    # NPK
            4.1, 3.8, 4.3, 3.9, 4.2,    # Compost
            5.4, 5.9, 5.3, 5.7, 5.6)    # Mixed

rice <- data.frame(treat = factor(treat), yield)

y_bar <- tapply(rice$yield, rice$treat, mean)
#> Compost   Mixed     NPK    Urea 
#>    4.06    5.58    5.10    4.38
```

```{r}
boxplot(yield ~ treat, data = rice,
        col = "#dbeafe", border = "#2563eb",
        xlab = "Fertilizer", ylab = "Rice yield (Mg/ha)",
        main = "BARI Rice Trial 2024")
```

```{r}
a <- 4;  n <- 5;  N <- a * n

sum_y = sum(rice$yield)
sum_y2 = sum(rice$yield^2)
treat = tapply(rice$yield, rice$treat, sum)
sum_treat = sum(treat)
sum_treat2 = sum(treat^2)

cf = sum_y^2 / N
sst = sum_y2 - cf
ss_treat = sum_treat2 / n - cf
sse = sst - ss_treat

ms_treat = ss_treat / (a - 1)
mse = sse / (N - a)
f_calc   <- ms_treat/mse
f_calc
```

```{r}
se <-  sqrt(mse/n)
tcrit <- qt(1-.05/2/4, N-a)

ci_table <- data.frame(
  Lower = y_bar - tcrit * se,
  Upper = y_bar + tcrit * se
)

ci_table

```
```{r}
tcrit <- qt(1-.05/2, N-a)
ci_table <- data.frame(
  Lower = y_bar - tcrit * se,
  Upper = y_bar + tcrit * se
)

ci_table
```
```{r}
treatment_names <- rownames(ci_table)
pairs <- combn(treatment_names, 2)

# ৩. লুপ চালিয়ে ওভারল্যাপ পরীক্ষা করা
overlap_results <- data.frame(
  Treatment_1 = pairs[1, ],
  Treatment_2 = pairs[2, ],
  Overlap = NA
)

for(i in 1:nrow(overlap_results)) {
  t1 <- overlap_results$Treatment_1[i]
  t2 <- overlap_results$Treatment_2[i]
  
  # ওভারল্যাপের শর্ত পরীক্ষা
  is_overlapping <- ci_table[t1, "Lower"] <= ci_table[t2, "Upper"] && 
                     ci_table[t1, "Upper"] <= ci_table[t2, "Lower"]
  
  overlap_results$Overlap[i] <- is_overlapping
}

# ফলাফল প্রদর্শন
print(overlap_results)
```
```{r}
model <-  aov(yield ~ treat, data = rice)
TukeyHSD(model, conf.level = 0.95)

qq()
```
